data.name: Noelia
data.gender_notes: Noelia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Hannah', which means grace or favor. In the Bible, Hannah prayed to God for a son and was blessed with a baby girl named Samuel. Noelia is a variant of this name, which means 'wealthy in God'. The name Noelia carries the meaning “Wealthy in God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Spanish. Parents who choose Noelia usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy in god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rich in faith and divine favor.
data.etymology: Noelia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealthy in God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noelia total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: נואליה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא אור (Elokim hu or) - God is light
in_hebrew.long_meaning: נואליה הוא שם שמקורו במילה העברית 'נואל' שפירושה 'אלוהים הוא אור'. השם נגזר מהשורש 'נ-ו-א' שמשמעותו 'להאיר' או 'להאיר את הדרך'. השם נואליה משמש כנראה כהתייחסות לאור האלוהי המנחה והמוביל את הנושא את השם. במסורת הנוצרית, השם נואליה עשוי להיות קשור לנושא האור הרוחני והאור של אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Νοηλία
in_greek.meaning: Θεός είναι φως (Theos einai phos) - God is light
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νοηλία προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'Noel' που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι φως'. Η λέξη 'Noel' προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή ρίζα 'נ-ו-א' που σημαίνει 'να φωτίσει' ή 'να φωτίσει τον δρόμο'. Στην παράδοση των Χριστιανών, το όνομα Νοηλία πιθανόν να σχετίζεται με το πνεύμα του divine φωτός και τον φωτισμό που προσφέρει ο Θεός.

in_latin.name: Noelia
in_latin.meaning: Deus est lux - God is light
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Noelia originem habet in voce hebraea 'Noel', quae significat 'Deus est lux'. Vox 'Noel' derivatur a radice hebraea 'נ-ו-א', quae significat 'illuminare' aut 'viam illuminare'. In traditione christiana, nomen Noelia probabiliter refertur ad lucem divinam et illuminationem quam Deus praebet.

in_english.name: Noelia
in_english.meaning: God is light, shining one, or Christmas
in_english.long_meaning: The name Noelia originates from the Hebrew word 'Noel', meaning 'God is light'. It is derived from the Hebrew root 'נ-ו-א' which means 'to shine' or 'to light the way'. In Christian tradition, Noelia is associated with the spiritual light and illumination provided by God. The name is also linked to Christmas, as 'Noel' is a term often used to refer to the holiday. Noelia symbolizes hope, guidance, and divine presence. It has been used across various Christian cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and significance.
